decisions.statement: The tracker listens only while the player is inside Imperial City.
The one-second loop keeps running in Cyrodiil so a timer survives a zone change.
A boss counts as dead only where the reticle saw that boss alive in the last minute.
A kill shared with the group has the district rather than the boss.
A group broadcast is sent only where LibGroupBroadcast is loaded.

definition: what the tracker does when a boss dies, a zone changes or a group member shares
